status: Author implementation complete and frozen for independent review
behavior: Diary dates and Today come from the server in America/Mexico_City; a month is bounded to31 days and the helper rejects more than62 inclusive days.
Only explicit water/meal/completion actions PATCH the selected day with expected_version. Merely showing a plan, selecting foods, opening a dialog or changing dates writes nothing.
Consumption totals and foods use recorded server snapshots. Completion is a separate mark. Replacing a meal resets only that mark and preserves other meals and water.
Conflict and ambiguous delivery keep the draft in memory, require readback, show current persisted values, and require another explicit registration. No automatic replay or overwriting.
The selection freezes the displayed persisted plan_id. A later generated plan does not change that source or its exact PDF.

Context revision and canonical subject checks fence API results and rendered state. A role/session-version revocation discards old session data while a fresh personal login keeps its diary. Ambiguous usuario/OWNER never adopts a professional portfolio.

Six-collection export adds personal_diary and exclusive ISO date after_diary, with bounded explicit parts, complete records, filtered finished collections and truthful manifests. No export persistence or third-party request.

The logout handler no longer clears all browser storage. The additive auth.logout result distinguishes verified empty local credentials from server confirmation, preserves a newer login and surfaces Storage errors without fallback deletion.
legacy_policy: No reads, import, attribution or deletion of unidentified mb_daily_/mb_water_/mb_meals_/mb_meals_done_ values. Synthetic unreadable-value canaries remained byte-identical across diary/calendar/export/logout/login, including faults. The notice says old local records are not synchronized.
doubles: Welcome delivery is a no-send fixture boundary; outbound sockets are blocked before product imports.
The client clock/timezone is deliberately set to2042/Auckland while actual server dates are used.
Named browser routes hold or lose real committed responses; export requests explicitly reduce the real API limit to1 and one negative response replaces only after_diary with an invalid UUID.
VM tests use synthetic Storage and transport, not browser/backend proof.
limits: This is isolated author evidence. Independent QA/security and integration remain pending; no production/provider/deployment claim.
SQLite metadata preparation does not demonstrate Alembic or PostgreSQL RLS. Backend migration/PG reviews are separate.
The old plan-history list remains unpaginated in the pre-existing backend contract. Only diary calendar queries are bounded here.
Two legacy authentication keys remain non-atomic across reload, direct external writers and tabs. The additive logout result does not close R10 or durable/cross-tab atomicity.
Axe assertions cover the eight stable rendered states after finite animations settle, plus keyboard interaction; they are not an all-state compliance certification.
Download evidence verifies Blob/anchor execution and bytes received by the browser, not that a human saved a file.
No old local diary values were migrated or assigned. No purchases/progress/new domains, quota policy or backend/model changes were added by this UI commit.
